posts.author: Lin
posts.title: Liquid Glass on a tab bar
posts.preview: A translucent capsule, a lens behind the selected item and a spring when it moves: the three things that make the tab bar feel like glass.

posts.author: Mia
posts.title: One package per animation library
posts.preview: Lottie, PAG, Rive and GIF each live in their own package, so the 2 MB main package only carries the runtime you use.

posts.author: Kai
posts.title: Spring easing that feels native
posts.preview: cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) overshoots just enough: use it for a lens that springs in and a card that scales in.

posts.author: Ava
posts.title: A raised plus button with its own page
posts.preview: The plus button bulges above the bar and selects a page, like the iOS example: the same configuration file drives every platform.

posts.author: Leo
posts.title: Swift names for underscored methods
posts.preview: Add a method without the underscore and give it a Swift name, so the Objective-C API stays and Swift reads naturally.

posts.author: Zoe
posts.title: Badges read with their tab
posts.preview: VoiceOver reads "Discover, 3": the badge is part of the tab's label, never a separate element.
